denominator.definition: One priced entry or named formula from SRD Equipment tables pp. 63–72; bundles once, barding formula once, tools vehicle cross-reference excluded; stabling and food/lodging/hirelings are service commerce in SERVICE_COVERAGE.md. Not a percentage of all SRD magic items/spells. Near matches with different function/capacity are not represented.

statusDefinitions.complete: Named equivalent present, no flagged pricing/mechanics issue; intentional documented weight adjustments allowed.
statusDefinitions.needs-review: Intentional price departure needs policy decision, or a near match needs unit/function review.
statusDefinitions.missing: No canonical equivalent or functional candidate.
statusDefinitions.duplicate: More than one same-function canonical record.
